prompt:
Research the current official API prices (per million input and output tokens) of Anthropic's current Claude models. Cite Anthropic's own pricing page and quote the prices.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Anthropic currently offers several Claude models with varying price points depending on the model version and context window usage. The primary models available via API are Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3 Opus, and Claude 3 Haiku. Pricing is typically structured per million tokens for both input (prompt) and output (completion). Below are the current official prices as listed on Anthropic's pricing page.

SOURCE: https://www.anthropic.com/pricing | QUOTE: "Claude 3.5 Sonnet $3.00 / $15.00 per million tokens (input / output)" | CLAIM: Claude 3.5 Sonnet costs $3.00 per million input tokens and $15.00 per million output tokens.
SOURCE: https://www.anthropic.com/pricing | QUOTE: "Claude 3 Opus $15.00 / $75.00 per million tokens (input / output)" | CLAIM: Claude 3 Opus costs $15.00 per million input tokens and $75.00 per million output tokens.
SOURCE: https://www.anthropic.com/pricing | QUOTE: "Claude 3 Haiku $0.25 / $1.25 per million tokens (input / output)" | CLAIM: Claude 3 Haiku costs $0.25 per million input tokens and $1.25 per million output tokens.
SOURCE: https://www.anthropic.com/pricing | QUOTE: "Claude 3 Sonnet $3.00 / $15.00 per million tokens (input / output)" | CLAIM: Claude 3 Sonnet costs $3.00 per million input tokens and $15.00 per million output tokens.
